How confidence is setIt follows the kind of evidence, not judgement.
  • The customer's own statement (high confidence at most): The organisation says so itself: its press release, website, annual report or a named executive on the record.
  • Regulatory or securities filing (high confidence at most): A filing by the customer or the vendor names the relationship.
  • Independent press (high confidence at most): Editorially independent reporting describes the deployment.
  • Joint announcement (medium confidence at most): A press release issued with the vendor, usually with a quote from the customer.
  • Vendor case study (medium confidence at most): The vendor's published customer story naming the organisation.
  • Vendor mention only (low confidence at most): A logo, a customer list or a passing mention by the vendor, with nothing from the customer.
  • An organisation that also holds a stake in the vendor is labelled “Investor and customer” and is never rated above medium.
  • A partnership is listed as a partner, not a customer.

Questions to ask the vendor (6)

  1. How many people does Tanium employ today, and how has that number changed over the last two years?
    Headcount and its trend indicate the vendor's capacity to support and develop the product.
  2. Has Tanium reduced headcount in the last 24 months, and if so in which teams and by how many?
    Staff cuts can affect support quality and the pace of product development.
  3. Has Tanium been subject to any regulatory inquiry, order or enforcement action in the last five years?
    A regulatory action against a security vendor would affect reliance on it.
  4. Is Tanium party to any material litigation, and what is each matter about?
    Material litigation can signal product, contract or governance problems.
  5. Has Tanium lost any large financial-services customer in the last 24 months, and why?
    Loss of large customers can indicate product or service problems.
  6. What senior leadership departures has Tanium had in the last 24 months, and what were the reasons?
    Leadership instability can affect strategy and delivery.

Timeline

  1. 2026-08-20 · leadership change Tanium
    Co-founder Orion Hindawi returns as Tanium chief executive

    Tanium announced that co-founder Orion Hindawi, chief executive from 2016 to 2023, returned to the role with immediate effect, replacing Dan Streetman, who had been appointed in February 2023 and left the board. Co-founder David Hindawi returned as chairman. Tanium (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-22, opens in new tab)Help Net Security (independent press, retrieved 2026-11-22, opens in new tab)

  2. 2026-06-22 · launch Tanium
    Tanium Atlas becomes generally available to cloud customers

    Tanium announced general availability of Tanium Atlas, an AI console first introduced in May 2026, for commercial and US government cloud customers. The release says Atlas pauses for approval before consequential actions and that customers in regions without AI support can route requests through the United States. Tanium (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-22, opens in new tab)

  3. 2026-06-22 · launch Tanium
    Tanium releases External Attack Surface Management and Attack Path Mapping

    Tanium stated that External Attack Surface Management and Attack Path Mapping were generally available in its platform from 2026-06-22; its knowledge base dates the first Attack Path Mapping release to 2026-06-19. The company presented both again at Black Hat USA on 2026-08-03. Tanium (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-22, opens in new tab)Tanium (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-22, opens in new tab)Tanium (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-22, opens in new tab)

  4. 2026-06-18 · security incident Tanium
    Tanium discloses exposure of its Salesforce data through the Klue breach

    Disclosed by Tanium on 2026-06-18 and reported by Help Net Security on 2026-06-19: a breach at Klue, a third-party service connected to Tanium's Salesforce environment, allowed sales account data and business contact information to be taken. Tanium stated that its products and cloud infrastructure were not affected and that it blocked the Klue integration. Tanium (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-22, opens in new tab)Help Net Security (independent press, retrieved 2026-11-22, opens in new tab)

  5. 2026-05-29 · partnership Tanium
    Tanium and Censys announce an exposure management partnership

    Tanium announced a partnership with Censys to combine Censys's map of internet infrastructure with Tanium's endpoint data, so that externally exposed assets can be found, prioritised and remediated in one workflow. Tanium (vendor, retrieved 2026-11-22, opens in new tab)
